    12  # Pontryagin dual
    13  
    14  This file defines the Pontryagin dual of a topological group. The Pontryagin dual of a topological
    15  group `A` is the topological group of continuous homomorphisms `A →* Circle` with the compact-open
    16  topology. For example, `ℤ` and `Circle` are Pontryagin duals of each other. This is an example of
    17  Pontryagin duality, which states that a locally compact abelian topological group is canonically
    18  isomorphic to its double dual.
    19  
    20  ## Main definitions
    21  
    22  * `PontryaginDual A`: The group of continuous homomorphisms `A →* Circle`.
    23  -/

    28  open Real
    29  
    30  variable (A B C G H : Type*) [Monoid A] [Monoid B] [Monoid C] [CommGroup G] [Group H]
    31    [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B] [TopologicalSpace C]
    32    [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
    33  
    34  noncomputable section
    35  
    36  /-- The Pontryagin dual of `A` is the group of continuous homomorphism `A → Circle`. -/

    38    A →ₜ* Circle
